snippet.title: Club Soko (Prototype) - Crazy Web Game Jam 2024 Entry
snippet.description:
Club Soko is a sokoban style puzzle game.

In Club Soko, the bouncers push you when you get too close. Read the room and outsmart the bouncers using what you have around you. Each level is carefully crafted to teach you new, surprising and tricky ways of delving deeper and deeper into Club Soko~

Play the game for free here: https://www.crazygames.com/preview/b1511304-0557-42d7-a9bd-ca4f839fda56

Made for the Crazy Web Game Jam 2024.

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/MYWmsNQ

Wishlist it on Steam 👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3346410/Club_Soko/
